what: An interventions change on a trial's Changes tab now lists Removed and Added names, each reading None when empty, one name per line.
The interventions that stayed are counted (Unchanged 6 interventions); their names open and close behind a Show / Hide button.
A reordered list, or one where only a repeated name's count moved, is no longer reported as a change anywhere in the app.
Every other field still shows Previously / Now, and the History tab, change summary and export read as before.
so_what: You can see which drug a competitor dropped or added without comparing two lists name by name.
Try first: open NCT03412565 after a check that removes Carfilzomib; the card should read Removed Carfilzomib, Added None, Unchanged 6 interventions.
now_what: The build changed what the app detects, beyond the display: an interventions change that adds and removes nothing is no longer recorded, and old ones like it are hidden everywhere.
Those hidden old changes stay in your database; I could not check whether yours holds any, because the build had no copy of it.
An interventions list going from absent to empty is no longer reported as a change, because nothing was added or removed.
Added is drawn in the app's teal accent rather than a true green, because the stylesheet has no green; the words Removed and Added carry the meaning.
The developer simulator makes an addition of Carfilzomib, not a removal; the removal in the walk-through comes from the stand-in registry.
The walk-through did not try Safari for the new card, a save failing mid-review, or a background check adding a change while the page is open.

walk_through.title: An intervention that was dropped is listed under Removed
walk_through.legend: A check found that this trial no longer lists Carfilzomib. Its card should read Removed: Carfilzomib, Added: None, Unchanged: 6 interventions. Pressing Show should open the six names, and pressing it again should close them.

walk_through.title: An intervention that was added is listed under Added
walk_through.legend: A simulated check finds Carfilzomib added to this trial. The card should read Removed: None, Added: Carfilzomib, under the heading that says the changes are simulated. Mark reviewed is then pressed, and the card should show as reviewed.

walk_through.title: A list that was replaced, emptied or filled reads correctly on each side
walk_through.legend: First trial: both interventions were replaced, so two names should sit under Removed, two under Added, and Unchanged should say None. Second trial: one change emptied the list and an earlier one filled it; each card should say None on its empty side.

walk_through.title: A name with a comma in it stays one entry
walk_through.legend: One intervention is named Interferon alfa-2b, recombinant, and the registry later split it into two names. The one name should sit on a single line under Removed, and the two names on separate lines under Added.
